versions.changelog:
- Initial release of A股财报审阅助手 (A-Share Earnings Reviewer).
- Provides detailed analysis of quarterly, half-year, and annual reports for covered A-share listed companies.
- Reads financial statements and earnings call transcripts to update financial models and highlight key changes relevant to investment logic.
- Outputs institution-grade earnings update reports (6–10 pages, 2,500–4,000 characters, tables/charts included) within 24–48 hours of report publication.
- Follows domestic broker research report formats and workflow; prioritizes real-time data from authoritative Chinese financial sources.
- Focuses on earnings surprises, profit forecast revisions, and updates to investment theses.
